I reviewed the five "Change summary" variants, fixed the defects I found, and recommend `one-line`. Type check, oxlint, and oxfmt are clean for the surface, and no capture printed a console error, a page error, or a hydration warning.

Invoked skills: `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-code-style`.

**What was wrong and is now fixed**
- **Fact chips:** in the explorer cell (315 px) the region chip wrapped alone to a second line in three of eight scenarios. The chips now stay on one line, in the order of the spec (ratio, pixels, regions, size).
- **Region list:** the table had a `Size` column that floated in the middle and crops too small to read. The size now stands beside a wider crop, and the place is quiet at the end.
- **Magnitude glyph:** the outline bar of `tolerated` was 3.5 px tall and could not be read, and the map edge almost vanished in light. Both are now legible.
- **Shared facts:** a changed comparison with an empty region list would have read `0 regions`. It now gives no region fact.

**What I checked by use**
- Tooltips by hover and by keyboard focus (one line, glyph, sentence, region chip).
- Region stepping by click, `C`, and `Shift+C`, with the mark on the stage.
- Row selection, `Show 15 more` with the focus on row 9, and the Baseline and Current rows.
- A key pressed in Fact chips does not change Region list. Nothing takes the focus or scrolls the page on load. No horizontal overflow at 1440 or on a 390 px viewport.

**Looks checked**
- All five variants: dark and light, `data=today`, a 390 px viewport, and orange with sharp radius and compact density.
- One line, Fact chips, and Region list: also violet with round radius, comfortable density, and a warm canvas in light.

**Not changed, on purpose**
- `large` keeps the fixture numbers (3.47%, 44,453 px). So no scenario reaches 10%, and the fifth glyph bar and the emphasized ratio chip are still never visible. A fixed 38% would not match the mask on the stage, and the catalog does not mark `large` as lab only.

details-panel.summary:
I reviewed and fixed all 5 variants of `details-panel`; each one renders the 8 scenarios, and I recommend `facts` with `strip` as the runner-up. Type check, oxlint, and oxfmt are clean for the lab and for the 8 files of this surface. The final captures show no console error, hydration warning, failed request, focus on load, or horizontal overflow (explorer at 1440 in dark and light, and at a 390 px viewport).

Skills invoked: `ariakit-general-workflow` and `ariakit-general-code-style` (no repository-specific workflow skill exists for ariakit/visonaut).

The main defects I found and fixed:

- **Escape did not close the popovers** of `facts` and `strip`, although the builder reported that it did. Each open Ariakit dialog marks the rest of the page as outside, and a marked dialog ignores Escape, so a page with many open popovers never closes one. The variant root now handles the key:

  ```tsx
  <div onKeyDown={getEscapeHandler(open, () => toggle(false))}>
  ```

  Escape now closes only its own popover, from the trigger and from inside, and the focus returns to the trigger.
- **`strip`**: the stage and the fact line each had their own rounded corners at the seam, and a wrapped line ended with a loose separator dot.
- **`visual`**: the dashed baseline outline lay on the solid current outline, so the two translucent edges added up, and the meter was dark brown in light.
- **`two-columns`**: an absent image repeated `None` or `Deleted` in every row, and the row labels were louder than the values.
- **`facts`**: the values moved 9 px between scenarios, because the label column was narrower than `Compared with`.

Things to know:

- In the `row` layout, the explorer ignores `width=390`. I checked the narrow case with a 390 px viewport instead; both captures are in the list.
- The copied debug text no longer has `changed N px ratio 1` for a variant without a mask (added, size change), because those numbers do not measure a change.
- The catalog still describes sample screenshots (`1280 × 720`, `@morikenji`), and the variants show the real fixture values. I may not edit the catalog.

Scratch scripts and all captures are in `/Users/diegohaz/.claude/jobs/f65a6229/tmp/design/shots/components/details-panel/`.

item-filter.summary:
Reviewed and repaired the 6 variants of `item-filter` (one-field, status-tabs, meter-filter, facets, tokens, jump). All 8 scenarios render in each variant. I looked at every variant in dark and light, with data=today, brand=orange, radius=sharp, radius=round, density=compact, on the explorer page at 1440 and at a 390 px viewport, and I drove each interaction on the explorer page with Playwright.

Defects found and fixed:
- jump: a text that matched only unchanged screenshots listed each row two times (React error `Encountered two children with the same key`). Cause: in the fallback case `rows` and `unchanged` are the same list. Fix in jump.tsx: `if (search.fallback) return search.rows;`.
- jump: the text did not find a filter command, so `rej` + Enter applied `Needs review`. Now a command that the text names comes first, and a text that matches nothing has no auto-selected item (`autoSelect={hasTarget}`).
- jump: the hand-opened palette showed the same field two times (trigger, then palette field). The palette now opens over its trigger with `getAnchorRect`, and the inline scenarios show the palette in the place of the trigger.
- tokens: the counts beside the suggestions were all 0 while the reviewer typed a key without a colon (`is`), because the key was also a search word. The counts now leave out the word at the caret.
- All variants: two long names with the same start were the same text after truncation. New part `parts/screenshot-name.tsx` cuts a name of more than 24 characters in its middle (`combobox-sel… onal content`), as the spec sketch shows.
- status-tabs, facets: a tooltip repeated visible text and covered the search field. New hook `parts/use-word-hint.ts` opens the tooltip only while the word is hidden.
- status-tabs and meter-filter looked alike (a row of marks and counts). The selected tab now also shows its word (`✕ Rejected 1`), and the meter shows every count.

Checks: `pnpm --filter @visonaut/lab typecheck` is clean, `pnpm exec oxlint` and `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` are clean for `apps/lab/src/explorations/components/item-filter`. The explorer page loads with no console error, no hydration warning, no scroll, no focus taken, and no horizontal overflow (1440 and 390 px viewports). A `/` in one instance moves the focus only inside that instance.

Notes:
- Playwright's default caret hiding adds an inline `caret-color` before late hydration ends and causes a false hydration warning. My scripts use `caret: "initial"`; without a screenshot the page has no warning.
- The dev server reloaded the page several times during the interaction runs, while other builders saved files. I ran each group again until it finished without a reload.
- One type check run reported an error in `src/explorations/pages/review/changes/feed-body.tsx` (not my file). The last run was clean.
- `?width=390` does not change a `row` surface, so `explorer-390.png` has the same layout as the 1440 capture. `explorer-phone.png` is the page in a 390 px viewport.
- Files added: `parts/screenshot-name.tsx`, `parts/use-word-hint.ts`. Scripts: `matrix.mjs`, `interact.mjs`, `hydrate.mjs`, `names.mts` in the shots folder.
- Skills invoked: `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-code-style`. No Visonaut-specific skill is installed.

item-row.summary:
Review of the 6 item-row variants (skills used: ariakit-general-workflow, ariakit-general-code-style). The builder's work held up well in all 8 scenarios, both themes, both data modes, and the looks that I checked: orange brand with sharp radius and compact density, and violet brand with round radius. I found and fixed three defects.

1. Tooltips showed the wrong content (real bug, all variants with a tooltip). One tooltip store was shared by many `TooltipAnchor` elements, and after the first hover the store kept a stale anchor: a hovered row or mark showed the text of another row, at the place of that row, or showed nothing. I replaced it with `useTips(placement)` in parts/pieces.tsx: one store for each list, and each anchor spreads plain pointer and focus handlers that set the anchor element themselves (400 ms wait, instant when another tooltip closed less than 300 ms before, no tooltip for touch).

```tsx
const rowTips = useTips("right");
const variantTips = useTips("top");
<NavLinkLabel {...rowTips.anchor} data-tip-row={row.key} />
<ListTooltip rows={list.rows} tips={rowTips} />
<VariantTooltip rows={list.rows} tips={variantTips} />
```

2. Name tooltips covered the rows around them in variant-marks and fingerprint. Row tooltips now open at the right of the whole row (`getAnchorRect` reads the row), and mark tooltips open over the mark, each from its own store. thumbnail and tree had no name tooltip, so a cut name had no full form: both have one now.

3. families: the family label sat about 1.5 px above its chevron and its count. It is now centered.

Verified after the fixes: tooltip text for 3 marks and 2 names in each variant that has them (the families names and the tree tooltip from one capture each), keys (Up, Down, Home, End, Left, Right, digits, A, X) change only the focused list, one Tab stop for each list, no focus and no scroll on load, no horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390, no console error and no hydration warning in the final explorer captures. Type check, oxlint, and oxfmt are clean for the surface. During capture the dev server sometimes answered 500 ("The Workers runtime canceled this request") when 8 previews loaded at once; that is not from these files.

notice.summary:
Reviewed the 6 notice variants against the spec, fixed the defects found, and recommend `bar-slot`. Skills invoked: ariakit-general-workflow and ariakit-general-code-style.

The build was solid: copy, scenarios, live behavior, themes, and look controls matched the spec. The defects were in the narrow layouts, in one list, and in one gap of feedback.

Fixed:
- bar-takeover, 390 px: Approve wrapped to a row of its own in `sending`, `queued`, `saved`, and `refused`. The cause was the minimum widths of the two buttons:
  ```tsx
  const sharesRow = "@max-[30rem]/strip:min-w-0 @max-[30rem]/strip:flex-1";
  ```
  In a narrow strip the receipt now stands in the place of the disabled Undo and shows the mark and the number only.
- on-the-thing: the last decision of a screenshot moved the stage, so that decision had no visible feedback at all. With 2 WebKit changes per screenshot, this was every second decision. A small mark at the run title (`ElsewhereMark`: ring and count, cloud and count, then a check for 3 s) now shows it.
- receipt-log: the mark of a failed row was larger and indented, so the names started at two edges. Every mark now has one size. The row action had a square corner (`$forceRounded` added). In a narrow strip the action goes under the words and `Saved` hides. The list is `30em` wide, so `Wrapped across lines · WebKit · Dark` is whole.
- status-line: `keys` in the legend was brighter than the words beside it (`$ink={60}`). In a narrow strip the second action (`Reload`, `Queue`) hides.

Checked: all variants in dark and light, the explorer page at 1440 and at width 390, a 390 px window, data=today, brand orange with radius sharp, radius round with density compact. On the explorer page with 48 instances: focus on the body at load, no scroll, no popup outside its cell, no overflow, and a key in one strip changes only that strip. Two captures logged a 500 and a 404 for a resource one time. They did not recur on the next capture.

Checks are clean for the whole lab: typecheck, oxlint, oxfmt.

**What I checked.** I captured the explorer at 1440 in dark and light and at a 390 px viewport. I captured each variant alone in dark, light, and `data=today`. - **Wide hyphen (pill, pipeline, ring):** `tabular-nums` was on every label, so `Auto-approved` rendered as `Auto - approved`. Only count text takes it now.
- **Pill on a selected row:** the stock badge text is a tint of its layer, so `Needs review` read green on the dark selected row. The pill now passes the named role to `$text`:
  ```tsx
  $text={invert ? undefined : getRoleText(mark.role)}
  ```

  ```tsx
  <Mark mark={sample.mark} pipeline={getRunPipeline(sample)} wide>
  ```
- **Ring, Auto-approved in light:** the neutral arc was almost black, heavier than Approved. The neutral fill now sets `$contrast: 0`.

**Interaction results.**
- Each compact mark is a tab stop and shows its word in a tooltip on focus (for example `Rejected · step 3 of 4` in pipeline, `Rejected · 15 of 30 decided` in ring).
- A click on a chip changes only its own group.
